objective.definition: Cross entropy + expected joint location error + supervised connected-joint vector error; projected ground truth, no fixed lengths or angle templates.

meta.implementation: Own hand weights continued from the previously trained Movira network; no external hand weights.
meta.annotationMethod: HaGRIDv2 provider MediaPipe auto-labels; not human-verified joint truth
meta.roiCondition: Ground-truth hand boxes and wrist-to-middle-MCP orientation used in crop evaluation; not end-to-end full-body hand accuracy.

configuration.selectedOn: Subject-separated validation 619 crops; zero false presence at .9 with greater coverage than .95

meta.definition: PCK10 = within 10% of square crop side, against provider auto-labels; not manual anatomical accuracy.

searchConfiguration.selectedOn: 40 full-scene development photographs only; applied only to compact recovery hypotheses; primary output unchanged

meta.dataLicense: Custom Public license with attribution and conditions reserved; not standard CC BY-SA. Original notice is packaged as LICENSE-HaGRID-data.pdf.
meta.dataCredit: HaGRID authors: Alexander Kapitanov, Andrey Makhlyarchuk, Karina Kvanchiani, Aleksandr Nagaev, Roman Kraynov, Anton Nuzhdin.
meta.deploymentRole: Recovery only when original own hand model rejects an image region; no external hand weights.
